events.title: Higher Open Anticipated For Hong Kong Shares
events.description: Ahead of Thursday's holiday for National Day, the Hong Kong stock market had moved higher in two of three trading days since the end of the three-day slide in which it had given up almost 600 points or 2.5 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,610-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the green on Friday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May Tick Higher Again On Friday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has moved higher in two straight sessions, climbing more than 700 points or 1.5 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 48,350-point plateau and it may see mild upside again on Friday.

events.title: Bargain Hunting May Boost Singapore Stock Market
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, shedding almost 65 points or 1.2 percent in that span. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,665-point plateau although it's due for support on Friday.

events.title: Japan Jobless Rate Climbs To 2.5%
events.description: The unemployment rate in Japan came in at a seasonally adjusted 2.5 percent in August, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications said on Friday.

events.title: Tokyo Inflation Jumps To 2.7% Annually In September
events.description: Overall consumer prices in Japan were up 2.7 percent on year in September, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications said on Friday.

events.title: Malaysia Bourse May See Recovery On Friday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market headed south again on Thursday, one day after snapping the five-day losing streak in which it had slumped more than 40 points or 2.5 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,630-point plateau although it may bounce higher again on Friday.

events.title: South Korea Consumer Prices Rise 0.3% In September
events.description: Consumer prices in South Korea were up a seasonally adjusted 0.3 percent on month in September, Statistics Korea said on Friday.

events.title: Steady Start Seen For Japan Stock Market
events.description: The Japan stock market has moved higher in back-to-back sessions, rallying almost 3,500 points or 5.6 percent along the way. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 68,950-point plateau and it may see additional upside again on Friday.

events.title: Mild Upside Seen For South Korea Shares
events.description: The South Korea stock market on Thursday ended the three-day losing streak in which it had stumbled more than 240 points or 3.5 percent. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 6,920-point plateau and it may tick higher again on Friday.

events.title: South Korea Inflation Data Due On Friday
events.description: South Korea will on Friday release September figures for consumer prices, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. Inflation is expected to rise 0.4 percent on month and 2.9 percent on year after adding 0.2 percent on month and 3.1 percent on year in August.

events.title: TSX Remains In Negative Territory; Tech, Energy Stocks Climb Higher
events.description: Canadian stocks languish in negative territory on Thursday, tracking a sell-off in global markets due to rising oil prices and elevated bond yields.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Sharply Lower
events.description:
The Switzerland market ended sharply lower on Thursday, like most of the markets across Europe, as higher bond yields and rising oil prices continued to hurt sentiment, prompting investors to exit counters. 

Data showing an acceleration in Swiss consumer price inflation in September hurt as well.

events.title: European Markets Slide To Multi-Month Lows Amid Energy, Yield Surge
events.description: European equities declined sharply Thursday amid rising oil prices and bond yields. The FTSE 100 fell 1.68%, DAX dropped over 1%, and CAC 40 lost 1.6%. Brent crude climbed to $101.50, up 3.5%. Regional inflation concerns raised monetary tightening prospects.
